import * as THREE from 'three';
import {
  Engine,
  InputSystem,
  MaterialLibrary,
  ParticleSystem,
  CharacterController,
  SpatialHash,
  UiLayer,
  SaveStore,
  Progression,
  generateHeightfield,
  buildTerrainMesh,
  buildSky,
  scatterInstances,
  createFacetedGeometry,
  createFoliageGeometry,
  sphereOverlap,
  type Collider,
  type FrameContext,
  type Heightfield,
  type System,
} from './engine';
import { BRAND, SEED } from './brand';

/**
 * Reference product used by the platform's own integration tests.
 *
 * It exercises every part of the runtime contract the coding agent must satisfy:
 * world construction, a character controller, collectible interaction, HUD,
 * persistence and the `window.__adafGame` inspection hook.
 */

interface SaveData extends Record<string, unknown> {
  collected: string[];
  level: number;
  xp: number;
}

class WorldSystem implements System {
  readonly name = 'world';
  field!: Heightfield;
  readonly colliders: Collider[] = [];
  readonly hash = new SpatialHash(10);
  private readonly materials = new MaterialLibrary();
  private sky: { dispose(): void } | null = null;

  init(app: Engine): void {
    this.field = generateHeightfield({
      size: 240,
      segments: 128,
      seed: SEED,
      amplitude: 26,
      frequency: 3.2,
      octaves: 5,
      spawnFlatRadius: 16,
    });

    const terrain = buildTerrainMesh(this.field, {
      bands: [
        { at: 0, color: 0x2c4c3b },
        { at: 0.4, color: 0x4c7a4a },
        { at: 0.75, color: 0x8a7f63 },
        { at: 1, color: 0xd8d8e2 },
      ],
      slopeColor: 0x5b5346,
    });
    app.scene.add(terrain);

    this.sky = buildSky(
      app.scene,
      {
        topColor: 0x2f5a95,
        horizonColor: 0xa8c4dd,
        sunColor: 0xfff0d0,
        sunElevation: 34,
        sunAzimuth: 128,
        fogDensity: 0.0035,
      },
      app.profile.shadowMapSize,
      app.profile.viewDistance,
    );

    const rockGeometry = createFacetedGeometry(1.6, 1, SEED + 11, 0.4);
    const rocks = scatterInstances(rockGeometry, this.materials.surface('rock', { color: 0x8a8577, roughness: 0.95 }), this.field, {
      count: 90,
      seed: SEED + 3,
      area: 210,
      maxSlope: 0.7,
      exclusionRadius: 14,
    });
    app.scene.add(rocks);

    const treeGeometry = createFoliageGeometry(6.5, SEED + 29);
    const trees = scatterInstances(treeGeometry, this.materials.surface('foliage', { color: 0x3f6d3a, roughness: 0.9 }), this.field, {
      count: 140,
      seed: SEED + 7,
      area: 200,
      maxSlope: 0.35,
      exclusionRadius: 18,
    });
    app.scene.add(trees);
  }

  dispose(): void {
    this.materials.dispose();
    this.sky?.dispose();
  }
}

class PlaySystem implements System {
  readonly name = 'play';
  readonly controller = new CharacterController({ walkSpeed: 6.2, jumpVelocity: 6.8 });
  readonly progression = new Progression();
  collected = new Set<string>();
  state: 'playing' | 'paused' = 'playing';

  private world!: WorldSystem;
  private input!: InputSystem;
  private ui!: UiLayer;
  private particles!: ParticleSystem;
  private readonly pickups: Array<{ collider: Collider; mesh: THREE.Mesh }> = [];
  private readonly store = new SaveStore<SaveData>('reference-game', 1, { collected: [], level: 1, xp: 0 });
  private avatar!: THREE.Mesh;
  /** Set through the runtime contract so automated tests can drive movement. */
  private forcedForward = false;
  private readonly moveVector = new THREE.Vector2();

  init(app: Engine): void {
    this.world = app.get<WorldSystem>('world') as WorldSystem;
    this.input = app.get<InputSystem>('input') as InputSystem;
    this.ui = new UiLayer(app.container, {
      accent: BRAND.accent,
      surface: 'rgba(10,14,24,.86)',
      text: BRAND.text,
      muted: 'rgba(242,245,251,.62)',
      danger: '#ff5c6c',
      radius: '14px',
      fontFamily: "system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif",
    });

    this.particles = new ParticleSystem(app.profile.particleBudget);
    app.scene.add(this.particles.points);

    this.avatar = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.42, 0.9, 4, 8),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: new THREE.Color(BRAND.primary), roughness: 0.6 }),
    );
    this.avatar.castShadow = true;
    app.scene.add(this.avatar);

    this.controller.position.set(0, this.world.field.heightAt(0, 0) + 1, 0);

    const pickupGeometry = createFacetedGeometry(0.42, 1, SEED + 91, 0.15);
    const pickupMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: new THREE.Color(BRAND.accent),
      emissive: new THREE.Color(BRAND.accent),
      emissiveIntensity: 0.7,
      roughness: 0.35,
    });
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i += 1) {
      const angle = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2;
      const radius = 26 + (i % 4) * 12;
      const x = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
      const z = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
      const y = this.world.field.heightAt(x, z) + 1.1;
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(pickupGeometry, pickupMaterial);
      mesh.position.set(x, y, z);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      app.scene.add(mesh);
      const collider: Collider = { id: `pickup_${i}`, position: mesh.position, radius: 1.1, height: 0, solid: false, tag: 'pickup' };
      this.pickups.push({ collider, mesh });
      this.world.colliders.push(collider);
    }
    this.world.hash.rebuild(this.world.colliders);

    this.ui.setChip({ id: 'score', label: 'Shards', value: '0 / 12' });
    this.ui.setChip({ id: 'level', label: 'Level', value: '1', progress: 0 }, 'right');
    this.restore();
    this.exposeContract();
  }

  update(ctx: FrameContext): void {
    if (this.state !== 'playing') return;
    this.controller.yaw -= this.input.look.x;
    this.controller.pitch = Math.max(-0.6, Math.min(0.6, this.controller.pitch + this.input.look.y));
    if (this.input.wasPressed('jump')) this.controller.queueJump();

    this.moveVector.copy(this.input.move);
    if (this.forcedForward) this.moveVector.set(0, 1);
    this.controller.update(ctx.dt, this.moveVector, this.input.isHeld('sprint'), this.world.field, this.world.colliders);
    this.avatar.position.copy(this.controller.position).setY(this.controller.position.y + 0.9);
    this.avatar.rotation.y = this.controller.yaw;
    this.controller.applyThirdPersonCamera(ctx.app.camera, this.world.field);

    for (const pickup of this.pickups) {
      if (this.collected.has(pickup.collider.id) || !pickup.mesh.visible) continue;
      pickup.mesh.rotation.y += ctx.dt * 1.6;
      if (sphereOverlap(this.controller.position, 1.1, pickup.collider.position, pickup.collider.radius)) {
        pickup.mesh.visible = false;
        this.collected.add(pickup.collider.id);
        this.progression.award(45);
        this.particles.burst({
          origin: pickup.mesh.position.clone(),
          count: 26,
          speed: 4.2,
          spread: 1.2,
          life: 0.9,
          size: 3.2,
          color: new THREE.Color(BRAND.accent).getHex(),
        });
        this.ui.setChip({ id: 'score', label: 'Shards', value: `${this.collected.size} / ${this.pickups.length}` });
        this.ui.setChip(
          { id: 'level', label: 'Level', value: String(this.progression.level), progress: this.progression.xp / this.progression.xpForLevel(this.progression.level) },
          'right',
        );
        this.ui.toast('Shard recovered');
      }
    }

    this.particles.update(ctx.dt);
    this.input.endFrame();
  }

  dispose(): void {
    this.particles.dispose();
    this.ui.dispose();
  }

  private restore(): void {
    const data = this.store.load();
    this.collected = new Set(data.collected);
    this.progression.restore({ level: data.level, xp: data.xp });
    for (const pickup of this.pickups) {
      if (this.collected.has(pickup.collider.id)) pickup.mesh.visible = false;
    }
    this.ui.setChip({ id: 'score', label: 'Shards', value: `${this.collected.size} / ${this.pickups.length}` });
  }

  private exposeContract(): void {
    const api = {
      snapshot: () => ({
        scene: 'valley',
        entities: this.pickups.length,
        player: { x: this.controller.position.x, y: this.controller.position.y, z: this.controller.position.z },
        state: this.state,
        score: this.collected.size,
      }),
      input: (action: string, down: boolean) => {
        if (action === 'jump' && down) this.controller.queueJump();
        if (action === 'forward') this.forcedForward = down;
      },
      save: () => this.store.save({ collected: [...this.collected], level: this.progression.level, xp: this.progression.xp }),
      load: () => {
        this.restore();
        return true;
      },
    };
    (window as unknown as { __adafGame: typeof api }).__adafGame = api;
  }

}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('stage') as HTMLCanvasElement | null;
  const engine = new Engine({ canvas: canvas ?? undefined, container: document.body, clearColor: Number.parseInt(BRAND.background.slice(1), 16) });
  engine.add(new InputSystem()).add(new WorldSystem()).add(new PlaySystem());
  await engine.start();
  const boot = document.getElementById('boot');
  if (boot) boot.classList.add('is-done');
}

void main();
